title: Kinetic modeling of methanol synthesis from renewable resources

model_assumptions.text: Catalyst deactivation neglected; only reactions (1)-(3) considered.
model_assumptions.quote: The catalyst deactivation is neglected and no side reactions beyond Eqs. (1)–(3) are considered.

model_assumptions.text: Langmuir‑Hinshelwood mechanism with adsorption, surface reaction, desorption.
model_assumptions.quote: The Modeling is based on the Langmuir-Hinshelwood mechanism and consists of three main steps: first adsorption at the surface, reaction at the surface and desorption from the surface.

model_assumptions.text: Single type of active centers (oxidized \(\odot\) and reduced \(*\)) are considered.
model_assumptions.quote: In the classical approach of Graaf et al. (1986, 1988) or Bussche and Froment (1996), a single type of active centers on the surface is assumed.

model_assumptions.text: Total numbers of oxidized, reduced and hydrogen centers are constant.
model_assumptions.quote: In a first step, constant total numbers of oxidized, reduced as well as hydrogen centers are assumed.
The other steps are assumed to be much faster such that equilibrium can be assumed for them.

model_assumptions.text: Catalyst deactivation neglected; only reactions (1)-(3) considered.
model_assumptions.quote: The catalyst deactivation is neglected and no side reactions beyond Eqs. (1)–(3) are considered.

model_assumptions.text: Langmuir‑Hinshelwood mechanism with adsorption, surface reaction, desorption.
model_assumptions.quote: The Modeling is based on the Langmuir-Hinshelwood mechanism and consists of three main steps: first adsorption at the surface, reaction at the surface and desorption from the surface.

model_assumptions.text: Total numbers of oxidized, reduced and hydrogen centers are constant.
model_assumptions.quote: In a first step, constant total numbers of oxidized, reduced as well as hydrogen centers are assumed.
The other steps are assumed to be much faster such that equilibrium can be assumed for them.

model_assumptions.text: Simplified kinetics use lumped rate expressions (eqs 11‑13).
model_assumptions.quote: The simplified Langmuir-Hinshelwood kinetics is not based on elementary reaction steps but on lumped reaction kinetics for reactions Eqs. (1)–(3) of the methanol synthesis.
